title: Quantum Field Theory — Correlators, Renormalization, Effective Theory and Topology Atlas
status: established-QFT comparator and technical extension of Tim/Great-Book/UPT field research
purpose: Consolidate the project's scattered QFT material into one technical grammar: field content -> action -> quantization -> correlation functions/propagators -> interactions -> renormalization -> effective field theory -> topology -> observables. This is an external scientific scaffold for evaluating UPT and Great Book field language, not proof of a Potato field.

tim_book_root: 2024 Great Book explicitly discusses QFT, quantum fields, field excitations, Higgs/symmetry breaking, vacuum/Infinite Soil and unified-field imagery.
later_project_root: 2025 UPT proposes a Potato field with fractional/nonlocal kinetic structure, gauge/interaction terms and gravity/SM sectors.
provenance.boundary: The equations below are standard/technical QFT scaffolding unless separately marked project-specific.

field_action_equations.real_scalar: S[phi]=integral d^4x [1/2 partial_mu phi partial^mu phi -1/2 m^2 phi^2-lambda phi^4/4!]
field_action_equations.qed: L_QED=-1/4 F_mu_nu F^mu_nu + psibar(i gamma^mu D_mu-m)psi
field_action_equations.yang_mills: L_YM=-1/4 F^a_mu_nu F^{a mu nu}, with F^a_mu_nu=partial_mu A^a_nu-partial_nu A^a_mu+g f^{abc}A^b_mu A^c_nu
field_action_equations.rule: A physical field theory starts with declared degrees of freedom and an action/symmetry structure; 'field' as metaphor is not enough.

quantization_routes.canonical: Promote fields/conjugate momenta to operators with canonical (anti)commutation relations under the chosen quantization scheme.
quantization_routes.relation: Canonical and path-integral formulations encode the same theory in overlapping domains when both are well-defined; they are not separate universes.

correlators.from_source: G_n=(1/i^n) delta^n Z[J]/delta J(x1)...delta J(xn)|_(J=0), up to hbar/normalization conventions
correlators.two_point: The two-point function/propagator describes field correlations and particle propagation structure; poles/residues encode particle-like excitations under standard assumptions.
correlators.project_insight: A field claim becomes scientifically useful when it predicts correlation functions or S-matrix/response observables, not merely when it assigns symbolic names to regions.

propagator_spectral_structure.meaning: The spectral density rho encodes how an interacting field's two-point function decomposes into mass/continuum contributions under the representation's assumptions.
propagator_spectral_structure.project_use: If UPT posits a new physical Potato excitation, the propagator/spectral structure is a natural place to define mass, poles, widths and continuum/nonlocal effects.

perturbation_and_diagrams.expansion: Correlation functions/S-matrix elements can be expanded in powers of couplings when perturbation theory applies.
perturbation_and_diagrams.diagram_rule: Feynman diagrams are terms/bookkeeping in a perturbative expansion, not literal little trajectories particles secretly travel between vertices.
perturbation_and_diagrams.project_boundary: Do not map symbolic Tree branches or life histories onto Feynman diagrams as if the mathematical semantics were the same.

renormalization_group.fixed_point: beta_i(g*)=0 for all relevant couplings at an RG fixed point
renormalization_group.anomalous_dimensions: Operator/field scaling can receive quantum corrections beyond classical engineering dimensions.
renormalization_group.project_relation: RG gives the Axis a rigorous scale-flow comparator: the effective description/couplings can change with observation scale while physical predictions remain consistent after matching.
renormalization_group.boundary: Renormalization scale mu is not an extra physical spatial dimension and RG flow is not automatically spiritual ascent.

effective_field_theory.meaning: At energies well below a cutoff Lambda, heavy/new physics can often be represented by higher-dimension operators suppressed by powers of Lambda.
effective_field_theory.upt_use: UPT is more credible as an effective-field-theory research programme if new Potato-sector operators, symmetries, cutoff and Wilson coefficients are explicitly declared instead of presenting one master Lagrangian as already fundamental.
effective_field_theory.known_limit: As new coefficients/couplings approach their null values, the model should recover Standard Model/GR predictions in the tested regime.

symmetry_breaking_higgs.vev: A nonzero vacuum expectation value arises at minima when the symmetry-breaking parameters have the appropriate signs.
symmetry_breaking_higgs.project_relation: Great Book/Tim Higgs language is strongest when it refers to a field configuration and excitation around a vacuum, not a person literally being the Standard Model Higgs boson.
symmetry_breaking_higgs.upt_route: The neutral-scalar and complex U(1)_P descendants already provide two technically distinct ways to add a Potato-sector scalar.

gauge_holonomy_topology.wilson_loop: W(C)=Tr P exp[i g integral_C A_mu dx^mu]
gauge_holonomy_topology.field_strength: F=dA+A wedge A in differential-form notation for non-Abelian connection (coupling/convention factors vary)
gauge_holonomy_topology.topological_charge_qcd_schematic: Q proportional to integral d^4x Tr(F_mu_nu Ftilde^{mu nu}), with normalization convention fixed by gauge generators/coupling
gauge_holonomy_topology.instantons: Finite-action Euclidean classical solutions can connect topological sectors and contribute nonperturbatively with weights of order exp(-S_E/hbar).
gauge_holonomy_topology.project_relation: This supplies rigorous versions of Return-with-memory, loop/holonomy and topology-changing/sector-transition language without equating moral history with gauge topology.

chern_simons_boundary_theory.action: S_CS=(k/4pi) integral Tr(A wedge dA + (2/3)A wedge A wedge A)
chern_simons_boundary_theory.importance: Topological QFT links gauge connections, knots/links/braiding and boundary degrees of freedom in specific settings.
chern_simons_boundary_theory.project_use: Strong external neighbor for braid/loop/Boundary research; no Timic Axis should be called Chern-Simons without a defined gauge connection/action.

schwinger_keldysh.use: Computes real-time expectation/correlation functions in nonequilibrium/open settings using forward and backward contour branches.
schwinger_keldysh.project_relation: Provides a real mathematical forward/backward-time structure relevant to older advanced/retarded curiosity, but it is not evidence of messages from the future or Timic time causation.

microcausality_and_nonlocal_actions.local_rule: [O(x),O(y)]=0 for spacelike-separated local bosonic observables in local relativistic QFT, with graded/observable refinements for fermions.
microcausality_and_nonlocal_actions.upt_nonlocal_warning: Fractional/nonlocal kinetic operators require explicit analytic structure, unitarity/stability and causal interpretation. Writing Box^alpha does not automatically define a healthy relativistic quantum theory.
research_questions: Is spectral density positive where required?

source_field_observable_chain.chain: J/source -> field response -> propagator/correlators -> interaction -> detector/observable
source_field_observable_chain.equation: phi(x)=integral d^4y G(x,y)J(y) for a linearized sourced field problem
source_field_observable_chain.project_connection: This is a rigorous physics ancestor of Father/source -> Spirit/propagation -> Son/manifestation only as a structural comparator. It does not establish theological identity.

new_project_laws: Field Test Law: a proposed physical field must specify action, symmetry, propagator/correlation functions and observables.
Diagram Boundary: perturbative Feynman diagrams are expansion terms, not literal biographies or hidden tracks.
Scale-Axis Law: RG flow is change of effective description/couplings with scale, not automatically motion in a physical extra dimension.
EFT Humility Law: an incomplete new sector can be scientifically meaningful as an effective theory without claiming to be a final Theory of Everything.
Topology Memory Law: holonomy/topological charge give real examples of closed-path or global information surviving local deformation, but the relevant mathematical objects must be defined.
Nonlocal-Kernel Burden: nonlocal/fractional operators increase rather than decrease the need for causality/unitarity/spectral checks.
